name: Loner
description: Although most Vargr are gregarious by nature, some prefer to be self-reliant or work alone. Some Vargr also follow this career out of necessity rather than the desire for solitude.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: You track and hunt animals for your pack.

prospector.name: Prospector
prospector.description: You look for new sources of raw materials on planets and asteroids.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.description: You explore and map unknown systems or survey new worlds for colonisation.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: You fail to provide for your pack or find suitable territory. Lose SOC −1.
mishaps.3: Another Loner is operating in the area and you struggle to be successful. Gain them as an Enemy.
mishaps.4: You crash on an uninhabited world or are stranded in a hostile region. Gain one of Animals 1, Recon 1 or Survival 1. You may remain in this career but you lose all Benefit rolls for this term.
mishaps.5: You are ambushed by a corsair band and lose all Benefit rolls for this term. Roll END 6+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.6: There is a gap in your memory and you have no idea what happened to you.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: A patron offers you a job. If you accept, gain DM+4 to your next Qualification roll and gain them as a Contact.
events.4: Your independence has forced you to rely on your own specialist skills. Roll EDU 6+ to gain one skill from your specialist skill table.
events.5: Your self-reliance allows you to adapt to all situations. Gain Jack-of-All-Trades 1.
events.6: You are boarded or attacked by a corsair band but you have nothing of value. Roll SOC 6+. If you succeed, the Corsairs offer you a position in their band and you automatically qualify for the Corsair career. If you fail or refuse, roll on the Injury table.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You find some salvage or abandoned goods on your travels. Gain one Benefit roll.
events.9: You have a successful expedition. Gain DM+1 to one Benefit roll for this career.
events.10: You thrive on adversity. Roll Survival 8+. If you succeed, gain +1 to STR, DEX or END. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
events.11: You excel at your career. Gain DM+2 to your next Survival roll and DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You hit the mother lode. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
